mapper.select: SELECT ledger_id AS ledgerId, ledger_no AS ledgerNo, amount, direction, ledger_status AS ledgerStatus, invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, ref_type AS refType, ref_id AS refId FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND ledger_no = #{ledgerNo} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ir.invoice_record_id AS invoiceRecordId, ir.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, ia.application_no AS applicationNo FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application ia ON ia.invoice_application_id = ir.invoice_application_id AND ia.is_delete = 0 WHERE ir.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ir.member_id = #{memberId} AND ir.record_status = 1 AND ir.is_delete = 0 AND ( ir.ledger_id = #{ledgerId} OR (ia.ref_type = #{refType} AND ia.ref_id = #{refId} AND #{refType} IS NOT NULL AND #{refId} IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY ir.invoice_record_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application (tenant_id, member_id, ledger_id, application_no, idempotency_key, application_type, application_status, invoice_type, invoice_title, tax_no, invoice_email, amount, ref_type, ref_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{ledgerId}, #{applicationNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{command.applicationType}, 0, #{command.invoiceType}, #{command.invoiceTitle}, #{command.taxNo}, #{command.invoiceEmail}, #{amount}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.sql: a.application_no, a.application_type, CASE a.application_type WHEN 1 THEN '开票' WHEN 2 THEN '补票' WHEN 3 THEN '红冲' ELSE '未知类型' END AS application_type_name, a.application_status, CASE a.application_status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '已驳回' WHEN 2 THEN '待开具' WHEN 3 THEN '已开具' WHEN 4 THEN '已红冲' WHEN 9 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END AS application_status_name, l.ledger_no, a.amount, a.invoice_type, a.invoice_title, a.tax_no, a.invoice_email, original.application_no AS original_application_no, ir.invoice_no, ir.invoice_code, ir.file_url AS invoice_file_url, a.review_remark, DATE_FORMAT(a.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS review_time, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application original ON original.invoice_application_id = a.original_application_id AND original.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.application_no = #{applicationNo} AND a.is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application original ON original.invoice_application_id = a.original_application_id AND original.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND a.is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application original ON original.invoice_application_id = a.original_application_id AND original.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.application_status = #{status} AND a.application_type = #{applicationType} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.invoice_application_id DESC
